# Match My Skin by Roopsee

> A free personalised skincare product matcher. Users answer questions about
> their skin type, sensitivity, concerns, age and gender, and get scored
> product recommendations plus AM/PM/weekly routines built from a live
> skincare catalog.

## Key pages
- [Skin Match Tool](https://roopsee.com/): the main quiz and product matcher
- [Product pages](https://roopsee.com/products/): individual product details, scores, ingredients, usage

## About
Roopsee is a skincare recommendation platform. The matcher scores products
by skin type (oily, dry, normal, combination), sensitivity, concern
(acne, dryness, pigmentation, etc.), age group and gender, then ranks
catalog products and builds a two-tier (premium / value) routine.
